Construction Services in Valley Center, KS

Valley Center is a north Sedgwick County community of roughly 7,500 residents along US-81 north of Wichita. The city has grown steadily as residents move north from Wichita seeking its school district and semi-rural character — and the housing stock reflects that growth pattern. The original Valley Center townsite has older mid-century housing, while the surrounding newer subdivisions have 1990s through 2010s construction on generous lots.

Wheatland Construction serves Valley Center regularly. We permit through the City of Valley Center for in-town work and through Sedgwick County for rural properties outside city limits.

What We Build in Valley Center

Custom Homes

Valley Center's continued residential growth has available lots in newer development areas on the north and west edges of the city. We build custom homes in Valley Center from foundation through finish — City of Valley Center permits, own crews throughout. See Custom Home Building in Valley Center →

Home Additions

Valley Center's 1990s and 2000s homes are aging into their first major renovation cycle — master suite additions, room additions, and bonus room buildouts are common in the established subdivisions. We match existing rooflines and finishes precisely so additions integrate naturally. See Home Additions in Valley Center →

Basement Finishing

Valley Center's newer poured-concrete basements are good candidates for finishing — solid structural integrity and code-compliant rough-in plumbing. North Sedgwick County clay soil creates seasonal moisture pressure that we assess before framing begins. See Basement Finishing in Valley Center →

Bathroom Remodeling

Valley Center's builder-grade bathrooms from the 1990s and 2000s are at or approaching end of useful life. We replace them completely — new tile shower or tub surround, new vanity and countertop, new fixtures, and proper exhaust ventilation. See Bathroom Remodeling in Valley Center →

Kitchen Remodeling

Valley Center's subdivision-era kitchens have builder-grade materials that are aging out — laminate countertops, basic cabinet boxes, and outdated lighting. We remodel them for function and durability with materials appropriate for long-term use. See Kitchen Remodeling in Valley Center →

Major Remodels

Some Valley Center homeowners are doing multi-room renovations — kitchen, primary suite, and main floor bathrooms in a coordinated scope. We manage those projects with a single contract and coordinated trades. See Major Remodels in Valley Center →

Roofing

North Sedgwick County sees significant spring hail and wind. Valley Center's newer construction has architectural shingles approaching end of rated lifespan. We install new roofing systems and handle insurance documentation when applicable. See Roofing in Valley Center →

Valley Center Permit Office

Residential construction in Valley Center permits through the City of Valley Center. Rural properties outside city limits permit through Sedgwick County. We handle all applications and inspections.

Valley Center is an active market for us — we know the housing stock and the permit office. Written estimates, own crews, no added charges.
